rows: Large accounts (₹50 lakh+) trading large caps; crash insurance
notes: Shared core rules. Entry: monthly StochRSI pullback; close above EMA 61 on monthly, weekly and daily; RSI above 50; NIFTY above its 200-day average.
Stop: the previous week's low. Exits: weekly Supertrend turns bearish, or the 25-day time stop.
Risk controls: 20% position cap; halve size at a 10% drawdown, pause 21 days at 15%. Idle cash in a liquid fund.
